tagline: The primary staple food grain crop across India
hubs: West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Bihar
descriptionEn: India's most extensively cultivated staple food crop. High water requirement with puddled standing water.
imageAlt: Lush green flooded paddy field with fresh rice seedlings
harvestingIndicator: 85% of grains in panicles turn golden yellow with grain moisture around 18-20%.
introTipEn: Maintain shallow standing water (2–3 cm) during tillering and panicle initiation. Avoid deep stagnant water which suppresses tillering.
efficiencyGain: 25% water saving with alternate wetting and drying (AWD)
micronutrientNote: Zinc deficiency (Khaira disease) shows rusty brown spots on leaves. Spray 0.5% Zinc Sulphate + 0.25% Lime.
stagnationAlert: Drain excess water during torrential monsoon storms to prevent submergence of young tillers.

fertilizerStages.fertilizerEn: DAP + Muriate of Potash + Zinc Sulphate
fertilizerStages.quantityPerAcre: 50 kg DAP + 25 kg MOP + 10 kg ZnSO4
fertilizerStages.applicationMethod: Incorporate into wet puddled soil during final puddling

fertilizerStages.stageEn: Second Top Dressing (45–50 DAT / Panicle Initiation)
fertilizerStages.applicationMethod: Broadcast evenly across the flooded plot

irrigation.frequencyEn: Maintain 2–5 cm water layer (Drain 10 days before harvest)
irrigation.criticalStagesEn: Transplanting to Tillering (1–30 DAT), Panicle Initiation & Flowering (45–70 DAT), Milk to Dough Stage (75–90 DAT)
irrigation.tipsEn: Drain excess water during torrential monsoon storms to prevent submergence of young tillers.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Dead heart at vegetative stage and white earheads (chaffy panicles) at maturity.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4G (10 kg/acre) or spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (60 ml/acre).

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Circular hopper burn patches of dried straw-colored plants.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Drain standing water and spray Pymetrozine 50% WDG (120 g/acre) directing spray at plant bases.

pestsDiseases.symptomsEn: Wavy translucent lesions starting from leaf tips turning grayish-white.
pestsDiseases.controlEn: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP (500 g) + Streptocycline (18 g) in 200 L water/acre.

harvestSteps.textEn: Harvest when 85% of grains turn golden and lower panicle grains are firm.
Completely drain field water 7–10 days before combine or manual harvest.
Thresh harvested bundles immediately to avoid grain discoloration.
Dry paddy on clean tarpaulin to 13–14% moisture. Expected yield: 22–30 Qtl/acre.
